_comment: Dev-server proxy for the container stack (anex/container-parity).
Points `ng serve` at a running compose stack so UI work does not need an
image rebuild — that costs ~7 minutes for the production Angular build,
npm run serve:container        # app on http://localhost:4200
Everything below is served by the real stack: real bridge, real database,
real accounts. Only the Angular bundle comes from the dev server.
Set SP_STACK_URL if the stack is not on localhost:18230.
